name: table-list-kr
note: Hand-made in the JSON the Bank of Korea's ECOS Open API guide (ecos.bok.or.kr/api, developer specification: StatisticSearch, StatisticItemList, StatisticTableList, their JSON rows and RESULT codes) as open-source ECOS clients document it, and the series codes the owner verified (722Y001, 901Y009) give for StatisticTableList (Korean names): nine of ECOS's tables and the groups above them, a list of its own total; ECOS lists many more. Codes 722Y001 and 901Y009 are as the owner verified them, 817Y002 and 731Y001 as open-source clients give them; 721Y001, the group codes and the English names are illustrative. No ECOS_API_KEY was used. Listed for a live check.
